message: 長い影

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh...! B-Bitter...」
After muttering that under my breath, I glance around. Fortunately, the lunchtime clamor drowned it out, and my voice didn't seem to reach anyone's ears.
Sitting alone at a table, my coffee isn't going down at all. I bent my principles as a tea lover and ordered coffee for a change of pace, but things aren't that simple.

name: Misa
message: 「A hymn for the Holy Night Festival... A hymn...」
Progress is sluggish. I rack my brains with my lyric notebook in hand.
I have mountains of work as Vice-President, yet with everything waiting on paperwork and confirmations, my hands are free. No reason not to spend this time writing lyrics.
I've heard there are plenty of writers out there who come up with ideas at family restaurants. I came here hoping some of that luck would rub off on me, too.

name: Misa
message: 「A hymn... No, not a hymn, an anthem works just fine, right, Sakura-kun?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nnggh...」
I try not to think about him, but that's impossible. Ironically enough, his advice was spot-on.
A song for everyone to sing happily together.
Not something themed around revering God, like a traditional hymn.
An anthem where everyone praises everyone else.
Can I really write lyrics that resonate with people like that...?

name: Misa
message: 「...Hmph, someone like you--」
Someone like him just coasts on natural talent, barely puts in any effort, and never thinks things through. Winning the election for Student Council President was pure luck, too.
That was just a fluke! In fact, he's practically overflowing with baseless confidence!
...That's what I had convinced myself, anyway, yet in reality, he wasn't that kind of person at all.
He worked even harder than I did.
And he suffered a massive failure, too...
He must have been overthinking things.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?! You're at Prier today too, Misa?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Misa, are you listening?」
Did I fail too, then?
...W-What's the big deal! So what if I did?!
Even if I did fail, I refuse to lose to you of all people...!
I have plenty to back up my confidence too, you know!
No matter the romance novel, just picturing the story in your head is meaningless. Unless you put it in writing, it's not a story at all--it's nothing more than a daydream.
And a song is no different!
It doesn't have to be in the form of lyrics yet. Don't worry about fitting a rhythm--for now, let's just write down what I'm thinking and feeling.
Unadorned and honest, wherever the pen leads.
Even if it's still faint, a single feeling will surely take shape there.
And--

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, that notebook... How's the Christmas song coming along?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyah!? I-It's not done at all! I'm so sorry! I'll do my very best!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why are you using polite speech?」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh my? It was you, Nanaka-san. I was completely convinced it was Sakura-kun.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't it still weird to use polite speech just because it's Synn?」

name: Misa
message: 「Um, w-well, that's, uhm...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, whatever. Sorry for startling you.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's quite alright, I don't mind. Bitter coffee is far more of a shock, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha--what a weird comparison.」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Do you think so? Oh dear. Could my sensibilities be going haywire because I'm making no progress with the lyrics...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm telling you, Misa, you're way too uptight.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn is totally relaxed, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just a minute ago, he went to the Student Council room saying he was going to take a nap because he's tired from magic training.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That part's fine, but what do you think Synn said to me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Teach me the secret technique to sleeping soundly at the Student Council room desk!' he says.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though we were finally alone together, that guy isn't conscious of me even a tiiiny bit.」

name: Misa
message: 「Giggle.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I were a dorm student like Azel, Synn would definitely come over to sleep. And without treating me like a girl, at that!」

name: Misa
message: 「But boys are forbidden in the student dorms, aren't they?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope! Even so, Synn would still come. No doubt about it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right. Misa, do you know about dorm songs? It's not directly related to the Holy Night Festival, but apparently the dorm students write a new dorm song every year.」

name: Misa
message: 「I know there are dorm songs, though I've never actually heard one.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't you give 'em a listen sometime? Might give you some ideas. There's decades' worth of them, so it's a huge amount, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've only ever heard like three or four of 'em myself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Some were total duds and some were masterpieces. But that's exactly what makes 'em authentic.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even I could tell when I listened to those songs just how much the dorm students really love the academy and dorm life.」

name: Misa
message: 「That sounds wonderful.」

name: Misa
message: 「I... I love the Student Council and everyone in it.」
I loved them...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that more than enough reason to write a song?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're right. It seems I was overthinking things. Thank you, Nanaka-san.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't need any thanks! More importantly, mind if I say one thing?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa, did you put sugar in the coffee?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geez, where the heck is that Demon Lord training, anyway?」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though we searched the entire academy, he wasn't anywhere to be found...」
After school. Even after it came to light that Sakura-kun was the Demon Lord, Student Council activities went on just as usual.
Rather, what changed was my relationship with Sakura-kun. Whatever we try to talk about turns awkward, and we can't coordinate properly as president and vice-president.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, that was a surprise. You're actually pretty bad at exercise, aren't you, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nnggh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, whenever you're racing Synn to school, you're crazy fast, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And yet, just walking around the campus left you totally wiped out.」

name: Misa
message: 「Whenever I challenged Sakura-kun to a race, some mysterious surge of power would well up inside me for some reason.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha, that's so like you, Misa.」
...Sakura-kun demonstrated tremendous concentration, fulfilling his duties as president in a short amount of time.
And then, after giving us the necessary instructions, he headed off to Melilot-san's place to hone his magic-his powers as the Demon Lord.
'Let's go peek in on Synn on the sly and tease him!'
Nanaka-san suggested that, and without even waiting for my reply, she took my hand and left the Student Council room.
'When the Student Council President is away, I, the Vice President, can't go abandoning my post too!'
...Such theoretical defenses crumbled all too easily before Onee-sama's smile and nod. I see--everyone is rooting for Nanaka-san and Sakura-kun's relationship too.
At least, that's what I thought at first, though today, if nothing else, turned out differently.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hahahaha! Still, precisely because it's so like you, Misa--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I really don't want you talking about it in the past tense.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, Misa... there's no need to beat yourself up just because Synn's the Demon Lord.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Demon Lord or whatever else, Synn is still Synn!」
Just as I thought.
Everyone is worried about Sakura-kun and me.
Feeling that most strongly of all, Nanaka-san had shown me Sakura-kun in his Demon Lord form first, and was now trying to talk things through with me.
Going so far as to throw herself into searching the entire academy until her legs were ready to give out.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I bet part of why he kept the Demon Lord thing a secret was the balance between the Student Council and the Crusaders, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He wants everyone to get along. See, Synn may be like *that*, but outside of romance, he's actually pretty good at reading the room, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plus, if his identity had gotten out the wrong way, they might've forced him out of the Student Council.」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're right. Sakura-kun became Student Council President aiming for a sparkling, ideal school life, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Exactly! Besides, just like the rest of us, Synn had never heard a word about the Kujou family's secret before either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He didn't know about Helena-san's role, right? Naturally he'd be scared that if his Demon Lord identity got out, he wouldn't just be removed as president--he might be expelled.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, come on, Misa...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Please, just forgive Synn!」

name: Misa
message: 「Forgive him or not, I'm not angry in the first place, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But since that night, things have been super awkward between you and Synn--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, whaaat?! Don't tell me you're just judging Demon Lord Synn without even giving him a chance!」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, what a wonderfully Nanaka-san way of putting it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tch, what the heck. Here I was worrying for nothing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Heeheehee!」
Yes, I'm not angry at all.
I am simply disheartened. Not with Sakura-kun, but with myself.
Nanaka-san understands Sakura-kun this much. She even reaches out to me.
Even so, I didn't get closer to Sakura-kun. I lacked the courage to take even one step forward--and worse yet, when he went out of his way to chase after me, I pushed him away.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, saying I lost out was a lie, though. You smiled, Misa, so it's all good!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san and Sakura-kun are somewhat alike, aren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grr! How rude!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, stop imitating me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahahaha!」
They say that close married couples grow more alike as they age, even though they started out as strangers. Wouldn't the same be true for lovers, or those who are more than friends?
...There's no room for me to wedge myself between Sakura-kun and Nanaka-san. Those two should just become a couple. And yet--

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm fine, really...」
And yet, why did Sakura-kun say he likes me? I didn't compete in anything and lose, so why do I feel so miserable?
I like you.
The instant it was conveyed to me clearly in words, I realized it.
I like him too--
No, I mustn't think like that.
The more I try to tell myself that, the more terrified I become of myself for falling deeper for Sakura-kun.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn is a Demon Lord, the Student Council President, and a Crusader--he's totally all over the place, and yet he's still doing his best.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So let's do our best too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I can't let myself lose to him.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's the spirit!」
Nanaka-san casually said "let's" instead of just "I." She must have sensed that I'm still feeling down.
That kindness hurts.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, tomorrow I'm definitely gonna confess to Synn!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, wait--once tomorrow comes, tomorrow becomes today, and the tomorrow of tomorrow's today becomes the day after tomorrow, so, uh, umm...」

name: Misa
message: 「Heeheehee.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you laughed! I'm being serious here!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san.」
I take a breath and speak to Nanaka-san.
I had stolen away a precious day that Nanaka-san surely wanted to dedicate to Sakura-kun. I couldn't let her worry about me any more than this.
A sharp, prickling pain stabs at my chest.
...Putting on a fake smile is your specialty, isn't it, Misa? It's a skill you mastered back when you were given your own room, after all.

name: Misa
message: 「I'm cheering for you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ow... that hurts!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bye-bye, see you tomorrow.」
After giving my back a hard slap, Nanaka-san runs off while waving her hand.
Before I knew it, we had reached the spot where the three of us met every morning. From here on, our ways home diverge.
Bathed in the setting sun, Nanaka-san's long shadow briskly recedes into the distance. Until just a little while ago, I used to dash off just like that too, yet now my legs feel so heavy.
Yes, see you tomorrow.
I tried to call back loudly, to answer her like that, but I couldn't.
My lips are trembling.
My back is slick with sweat.
And yet I'm cold. So cold. Freezing.
My fingertips are numb. Pale. Ice-cold.
I can't run anymore.
